newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close lower, bonds quiet.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close lower, bonds quiet.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates continued to fall on Wednesday on loose liquidity and dealers said they expected further declines unless the central bank moves to mop up funds through NCD issues.
The overnight interbank rate finished at 4.607 percent against Tuesday's 4.778 end, with 30-day commercial paper down to 4.70-4.75 percent from 4.75-4.80.
The bond market was quiet due to the absence of fresh market-moving news. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was traded at 5.659-660 and the seven-year 84/2 bond yield at 5.585.
